items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I got a little boy called Sugar Babe and we put him in the act and made a trio

ctx.x: So anyway, I quieted him down on the idea of us boxing or anybody fighting in this group, after they saw me fight, they saw I was too good for this boy. So I got my papers daily with all impunity, nobody said anything against my getting them or nothing. So we all got along fine. Then I went to get into this Indianapolis contest to win a bicycle, you know, the first prize is a bicycle and so forth and I get that all right.

And then I played all the biggest theaters in Indianapolis from the New Royal, which is the biggest theater, and we got to Indianapolis, you know, I got a trio together. See it was only Buck and Bubbles at the time and then I got a little boy called Sugar Babe and we put him in the act and made a trio and we were the first Ink Spots, you

know. Buck and Bubbles and Sugar Babe were the first Ink Spots out of Indianapolis, Indiana, where Deek Watson who is one of the Ink Spots now, took the name and started the Ink Spots with Bill Kenny 'cause he's from Indianapolis -- Deek.
